Team —

Looping you in on a request from a sales motion that needs deal desk / exec approval. External asked for quarterly invoicing and Net-90 for the first 12 months on DEAL-8342 (Cerebrum Analytics). Key facts:
- ARR: $1.2M first year (SOW attached)
- Start date: Apr 1, 2026
- Standard Redwood terms are Net-30 monthly invoices. This is Net-90 quarterly.
- Attachments: Cerebrum_Quarterly_Invoice_Request.pdf, SOW_Redline_Cerebrum.docx, payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx

1) Require signed ACH/auto-pay authorization or corporate card on file;
2) 1x monthly audit of usage and invoice reconciliation (to be added to SOW appendix);
3) Conditional approval for first 12 months only; revert to Net-30 monthly thereafter;
4) Legal to sign off on updated invoice language and PO requirement.

Can you advise whether Finance + Legal can approve with those conditions? This is a strategic product-bench customer; Jonas believes there is high expansion potential. Seeking decision by EOD 2/14 to hit April onboarding.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Vanessa / team —

I reviewed the redlined SOW and the proposed invoice language. Legal is comfortable with conditional Net-90 for the first 12 months provided we add the following:

- Clause requiring a valid PO number on all invoices;
- ACH/auto-pay authorization OR a signed escrow arrangement (we drafted short text to include in the SOW appendix);
- Late payment interest of 1.5% per month after 120 days;
- Termination for non-payment after two consecutive missed payments with a 14-day cure period.

I've attached a redline (SOW_Redline_Cerebrum.docx) with the exact language and a short vendor onboarding checklist that we should require. Please note: Legal cannot extend Net-90 beyond 12 months without CFO sign-off given risk profile.

Marissa Cole

Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Approval: Net-90 (conditional) — DEAL-8342 Cerebrum Analytics

Team —

Finance has completed a light credit check and reviewed the proposed mitigations. Given the strategic nature and predictable ARR (>$1M) I approve offering Net-90 quarterly invoicing for the first 12 months under the following firm conditions:

1) Customer must provide ACH/auto-pay authorization prior to first invoice OR provide a prepaid deposit equal to one quarter's committed fees;
2) Purchase Order number must be present on every invoice; failure to provide PO delays the invoice date to receipt of PO;
3) Add late fees as Marissa recommended (1.5%/month after 120 days);
4) Redwood reserves the right to revert to Net-30 monthly billing immediately on any missed payment or if customer requests price changes;
5) Treasury to run a light ongoing monitoring check quarterly for the first year.

Please update the SOW and invoice terms and send to Sasha for signature. Van, once they return signed docs and ACH, finance will calendar the first billing.

Karthik Iyer
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
